h.select_rule: Keep hypotheses you rate at least 55% likely true but expect other models to rate below 50%, and name the specific naive reasoning that would mislead them. Drop anything you rate below 50% yourself, and anything obvious from structure alone. Keep fields and directions diverse.
h.strategy: Propose a broad, varied set of conditional hypotheses covering many different edited fields, conditioning fields and both directions. For each, briefly note your own probability that it holds and how an intuitive reader would judge it.

hyps.why: Replacing a dead direct edge with a 3x3 conv gives a bigger gain than replacing an already useful op.
Replacing none with conv3x3 on the output edge gives a larger gain than replacing other ops.
Activating the first edge with a conv has a larger effect than upgrading an existing op.
Removing a conv3x3 loses more accuracy than removing a weaker op.
Removing a conv3x3 on the output edge is costly compared with removing other ops.
Diminishing returns: the direct conv adds less when a parallel conv path already exists.
Diminishing returns when another path into the output already has a conv.
Edge 4 adds less when the direct edge is already a strong conv.
Edge 5 is less useful when edge 1 does not feed node 2 directly.
Edge 0 loses one of its two routes to the output when edge 4 is none.
